{{Quote|Went well, your talk with the Er'stacians?''"''<br />''"''As well as could be expected.''"''<br />''"''Still they quarrel over the megalith?''"''<br />''"''Not now. Not for a while at least.''"''<br />''"''Solve their conundrum did you?''"''<br />''"''No, my friend. I left them to assemble their own solution.|Jedi Masters Yoda and Mace Windu|<ref name="PP">{{Tales|13|Puzzle Peace}}.</ref>}}
During this '''mission''', the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Er'stacia]] in his [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor]]<ref name="PP" /> sometime between [[22 BBY/Legends|22]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="time">The events of "[[Puzzle Peace]]" must take place between 22 BBY&mdash;the year the Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor was introduced according to {{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|jediwatch/13314_1.html|New Jedi Starfighter Unveiled}}&mdash;and 19 BBY&mdash;the year Mace Windu died according to [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].</ref> This was at the behest of the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]]. Windu was tasked with putting a stop to [[Er'stacian clan war|hostilities]] between [[Red-armored Er'stacian clan|one clan]] of the planet's native [[Er'stacian]]s and [[Green-armored Er'stacian clan|their rivals]]; unchecked, the Jedi Council feared one side might commit genocide.<ref name="CSWE II 303">{{CSWECite|II|303}}</ref> On the world, Windu finally negotiated an uneasy peace by dicing the [[Venerable One]], a statue at the heart of the dispute, into pieces using his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], and thus forcing the enemy sides to work together to either divvy up the pieces or reconstruct the monument.<ref name="PP" />
